title: Potato Anthocyanin Extraction and Purification
author: Yuanjun Yang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.k4mcyu6

steps.title: Prepare Macroporous Resin AB-8
steps.instruction: Pretreat the macroporous resin AB-8 to ensure it is fully swollen and clean.

substeps.instruction: Soak macroporous resin AB-8 with anhydrous ethanol for 24h until fully swollen.
Wash the resin with deionized water until no alcohol remains.

steps.title: Prepare Potato Tubers
steps.instruction: Clean and process the potato tubers for extraction.

substeps.instruction: Wash 250 g of potato tubers with distilled water.
Cut the tubers into large pieces.

steps.title: Extract Anthocyanins
steps.instruction: Smashed the potato pieces in an extraction mixture.

substeps.instruction: Smash the large pieces in 500 mL of a mixture containing 50% alcohol and 1.6% citric acid.

steps.title: Filter and Centrifuge Extract
steps.instruction: Clarify the resulting mixture to remove solids.

substeps.instruction: Filtrate the mixture twice using filter paper.
Centrifuge the filtrate at 4000 rpm for 10 min.

steps.title: Adsorb Pigments onto Resin
steps.instruction: Load the supernatant onto the prepared resin column.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant into a column filled with the pretreated macroporous resin AB-8 for 6 h to allow pigments to be absorbed.

steps.title: Elute Pigments
steps.instruction: Recover the pigments from the resin column.

substeps.instruction: Elute the pigments with 95% alcohol until the resin becomes colorless.

steps.title: Concentrate and Dry Eluate
steps.instruction: Remove the solvent to obtain concentrated pigments.

substeps.instruction: Concentrate the eluate using a rotary evaporator at 30 °C.
Dry the concentrated pigments in vacuo for 12 h.
